exposure: Antibiotic exposure in the prenatal period
Antibiotic exposure by month from months 2 to 12 of life
Antibiotic exposure by week during the first month of life
cohort: 4106 infants with 2 or more well-child visits after birth, with at least 1 visit at 300 days of life or later.
finding: Antibiotic exposure during the first month of life, especially at week 2 of life, may be associated with a decreased risk of developing atopic dermatitis.
